Error codes

Below are the error codes that determine the reason for the refusal to make a payment.

Информация

The code is returned in the Fail notification and during payment via the API.

The widget displays the message to the payer. In the API, the CardHolderMessage parameter contains this message.

Информация

For recurring payments, you need to set restrictions on sending repeat requests if error codes from the Unconditionally negative group were received. This means that subsequent recurring payments will not go through, and you will need to perform the setup transaction again.

Unconditionally negative

5005 — Do Not Honor

5057 — Transaction Not Permitted

5003 — Invalid Merchant

5017 — Customer Cancellation

5033 — Expired Card Pickup

5034 — Suspected Fraud

5001 — Refer To Card Issuer

5012 — Invalid Transaction

After 2 attempts from the Conditionally negative and Temporarily negative groups, payment processing will be blocked for 24 hours.

Keep this rule in mind on your side for the error codes below.

Conditionally negative

5055 — Invalid PIN

5063 — Security Violation

5014 — Invalid Card Number

5030 — Format Error

5013 — Amount Error

5054 — Expired Card

Temporarily negative

5065 — Exceed Withdrawal Frequency

5096 — System Error

5051 — Insufficient Funds
